_README: Copy to routine.config.json in your approved trading repository, and commit it there. All paths refer to the cloud execution host. It says where `node r3.cjs install` puts the tools and what they talk to. No secret goes in it: the operator supplies R3_KEYSTORE_JSON and R3_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD privately through the verified cloud credential settings (steps/I-setup.md I.2 section 7). Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
_signerAddress: The bot wallet: it signs, pays gas and holds every position.
_owner: Your own address, the only one the signer's supervised sweeps can ever send to. Must differ from signerAddress.
_allowlist: The signer's policy file, built once with `node <signer path> allowlist-init` (operator-run), committed in your private copy, and its sha256.
_planner: rpcGapMs and parallel pace the planner's RPC reads.
_dirs: Folders on the cloud host for the planner/helper, signer, keys and signer lock/log. All must be outside the project folder. Keep keysDir at ~/.r3-signer-keys where Claude's denied-tool rules name that folder; verify equivalent restrictions for other platforms. The reviewed install writes key files only when R3_KEYSTORE_JSON and R3_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD are both privately configured. Never commit those files or values.
_git: Who commits the run records, and to which branch, when a routine pushes them (--push).
